title: Fibonacci mod 1e9+7 for n up to 1e18
statement: Return F(n) mod 10⁹+7, where F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1 and n ≤ 10¹⁸.
hints: So the n-th power of that matrix holds F(n); compute it by repeated squaring in O(log n).

solution.explanation: Any linear recurrence of order k becomes a k × k matrix, and its n-th term is a matrix power, computed by repeated squaring in O(k³ log n). That turns "count tilings / paths of length n" with n = 10¹⁸ from impossible into 60 squarings. The scalar version (fast pow) is the same loop: square the base, multiply in when the bit is set.
